input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/scheduler.ts

The issue with the weekly scheduled export not sending on the initial day seems related to the calculation of the next run time in the `nextRunAt` function. Specifically, in the weekly case, the function always adds 7 days to the 'from' date without checking if the next scheduled hour has already passed on the current day. This causes the first scheduled export to be delayed by one full week if the schedule is set earlier on the same day past the RUN_HOUR_UTC.

To fix this, the logic should verify if the next run time today (at the scheduled hour) is still ahead of the current time and only then schedule to today; otherwise, add 7 days. This will ensure that a weekly export scheduled earlier in the day still runs that same day rather than the following week.

input.title: Fix first weekly export not being sent on creation day
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Adjust the scheduling logic to ensure that a weekly scheduled export sends the first export on the day it is created if the current time is before the export run hour. This fixes the reported issue where the first weekly export email is not sent on the creation day, but only on the following week. This change involves correcting the nextRunAt function to properly handle weekly cadence and the timing relative to the current time.
